info.title: Get CloudWatch Alarms
info.description: Retrieves active CloudWatch alarms for AWS resources

get.description: Returns a list of CloudWatch alarms filtered by state. Use this to check current alarm status for any AWS resource.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Alarm state to filter by: ALARM, OK, or INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Defaults to ALARM.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Optional alarm name prefix to filter results
